Added tests cover transport recovery, exhaustion, and server-error recovery. Webhook tests pass (8), the full suite passes (44), Ruff passes, and the diff has no whitespace errors.

Search rebuild performance was improved by replacing per-invoice embedding calls with an eight-worker batched helper (`CHUNK_SIZE = 100`) while preserving order. A baseline index test had two failures related to recently updated invoice descriptions; this behavior still needs investigation. Database inspection found a sequential scan for the unfiltered query and confirmed PostgreSQL selects `invoices_tenant_updated_idx` when the tenant predicate is present.

Staging writes must use Redis `cache-eu-3`, not draining `cache-eu-1`; use `ledgerly-shared-prod-nat`, never a service-specific NAT gateway.
